text: Week 23 - Coaching_Jenny_Huda_Wk23_2024-01-16_M_21640039753081d1U_2024-01-15_00-00-00 00:16:57 huda: —> As a minimum we expect: * Support for ours and ambassadors activities, this can be demonstrated by liking and sharing social media posts and being an active contributing member on the discord channel, Facebook group and LinkedIn group. * Inclusion of Ambassador status on social media, LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram. * Joining the Discord Server and the Ambassador only chat channel * Join our list of Ambassadors on our website, include photo, name, social media info. * Professional Behaviour and conduct online and in public. * Attend and/or take part in events run by the organisation or ambassadors. In a 12 month period It is desirable goal for Ambassadors to: * Run/co-run a workshop * Host a social event * Create a visible initiative 00:46:07 Jenny Duan: Economic disparity and wealth inequality in particular is a field that fascinates me, along with many of the other seminars offered through this program. I am highly interested in this experience and am grateful for the potential opportunity to learn from the opportunity to connect with Notre Dame professors as well as other students with the same passions. Most of all, I hope that the opportunity to learn from this enriching program will help impart me with the tools to continue my commitment to civil service and systemic change through participation in nonprofit and legislative initiatives in the future.
